positive.text: Supermercados Morelos went above and beyond with excellent customer service. This market is the best in Oklahoma City and has the best international market in the State. This location is located at a very convenient location near the interstate and prices are very low and affordable. The staff was very professional and friendly. They have a great huge selection of fresh meat 🍖 and bakery with a restaurant in the store so therefore if you are into South American / Mexican food or grocery this is the place to go.

Great place to grocery shop.  It's a Hispanic/Mexican influenced establishment with the benefits of cooking utensils, small pharmacy items, spices etc. It has a WONDERFUL choice variety of fresh fruits and vegetables. An abundance of fresh items surpassing the regular grocery stores and Walmart stupendously. The meat counter offers fresh butchered variety of meat items with different choices of livestock. Fun and unique shopping experience with festive choices for a market...with that being said, some general American brands and choices are somewhat limited!  Nice ,clean and fresh. Seems to be a well managed market of its sort!

El mercado está muy limpio y organizado, los empleados te atienden cordialmente.  Tiene una gran variedad de productos latinos y la comida que cocinan esta muy buena, la puedes consumir allí o para llevar.

09 12  2023  Update:

Well, I was going to the Dollar General and found it was closed. Well, I decided to venture into this nice looking STORE...and I ventured in.

The store was clean, and organized. I hadnt been in, but I was excited to come into to see if this would be better than going to Dollar General for snacks, and goodies.

Wow I was very surpised at the selection, and all kinds of Mexican goods, wide variety. Had a meat area, with a ACTUAL Person helping customers with orders...which is RARE. *get it RARE, meat...

I was going to get some things, then I noticed the PRICES...The prices, seem higher than normal than other stores which was rather disappointing. Maybe this is the Mexican version of WHOLE FOODS...whenyou have too much money for your own good.

So, one thing I did like, was the cooler of cold drinks,still the prices reflected 7 11....3.00 for a 2 liter?  So, I got one and left...disappointed...I went to another store to get my snacks.

Check it out, they have it, its nice inside, and clean.  Just watch the PRICES.
